programme.title: Deadliest Catch: Becoming Captain
programme.desc: On the brink of failure, Josh Harris discovers secret fishing grounds in his late father's logbooks a deck mishap could end Jake's season the Coast Guard braves pitching seas in an attempt to hoist an injured sailor from inside a ship's tank.

programme.title: Dino Hunters: Dinosaur Cowboys
programme.desc: Dinosaur fossil season has begun, and Montana rancher Clayton Phipps finds what might be an extremely rare and valuable fossil on his family's property.

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold: Dawn of the Dredge
programme.desc: Summer temperatures are at an all-time high, disrupting the sea floor and causing miners to find new strategies Shawn fights a legal battle Ken tries to keep his gold crown, while Emily and the Kellys look to expand their operations.

programme.title: India's Citizen Squad: A Test of Courage
programme.desc: Twelve civilians and six ex-military pros are tested in Kashmir Valley.

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Big!: World Biggest Car Factory
programme.desc: Richard investigates the gigantic Volkswagen car factory and the futuristic technology used by the factory in Wolfsburg, Germany.

programme.title: Dirty Mudder Truckers: The Dirty 7 vs. South Carolina
programme.desc: Team South Carolina heads down to Florida to challenge the Dirty Seven with both money and pride on the line, it's a scramble to get the trucks ready in time to race drivers have to push their motors to the limit and battle it out in The Pit.

programme.title: America's Worst Tattoos: It's Coming Out of My Buttcrack
programme.desc: A horrendous pink elephant tattoo a back tattoo in a bad location.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch: Purgatory
programme.desc: Circumstances force Keith to hand over the Wizard Josh fights for the helm despite a bad showing major engine trouble threatens Wild Bill's season.

programme.title: Dino Hunters: Million-Dollar Dino
programme.desc: Clayton Phipps continues his excavation of a rare carnivorous dinosaur on his Montana ranch Mike Harris and son Jake prepare to sell their prized Tyrannosaurus rex fossil Aaron Bolan hunts for an Ankylosaurus.
